name: cx-box
task: Carry the box to the exit, and whenever the box falls, pick it up again.

value.feedback: NO CHANGES NEEDED: Existence(at_exit) is the stated goal to reach the exit, and Response(at_exit, holding_box) is the carry-to-exit pattern. Since at_exit holds only on the final step, it requires holding_box on that step, which forces the pickup without a separate Existence(holding_box). Response(box_fell, holding_box) is the stated whenever-falls re-pickup rule and stays even though holding at the exit also implies it, because the task states it. All three clauses are hard with no preference cue, each traces to a task phrase, and none is added or missing.

texts: At the exit, be holding the box.
Whenever the box falls, hold it again afterward.
